states.meaning: The panda performs four rhythmic alternating whole-body toy hops with small raised-toe kicks and side-to-side turns. Its actual shoulder dragon anticipates, moves outward to viewer-left, rises into a short flapping flight beside the panda, returns and settles on the same shoulder. Arms retain their existing pose. Authored one-shot choreography, not physical flight or balance.

style: Premium animated-film character. Dense soft ivory and charcoal fur, warm brown expressive eyes, rounded plush proportions. Green dragon with fine scales, pale belly, horns and thin wing membranes. Preserve the reference palette and identity; no clothing, pedestal, text or extra characters.
subject: Muse panda with a small green shoulder dragon
